visualCharacteristics: Horizontal category-filter tab strip with uppercase labels; the active tab is highlighted with a filled block. Each tab reveals one content panel, typically a multi-up grid of borderless cards.
contentPattern: One row per tab. Cell 1 is the tab label; cell 2 is that tab's panel content (e.g. a card grid). The first tab is shown by default.
usage: Interactive category filter for listing pages (e.g. an adventures browser filtered by All / Climbing / Cycling / Skiing / Surfing / Travel).
